Temelli Jewellery

Temelli Jewellery specialises in fine diamonds and jewellery - all accompanied with internationally recognised diamond certificates - custom-made jewellery, repairs and servicing. Temelli also showcase a beautiful range of natural coloured gemstones, Australian south sea pearls, Argyle Pink Diamonds and a magnificent range of men’s and ladies timepieces.  Temelli operate their own jewellery workroom in Collins Street Melbourne, and create the unique and beautiful jewellery creations showcased within each of their Melbourne stores.
